name: 児童育成手当に関する情報利用規定を整備
summary: 市は、個人番号の利用などを定める条例を改正します。児童育成手当の支給などに関する事務で扱う特定個人情報の規定を整えます。

en.name: Sets rules for information related to the child-rearing allowance
en.official: Ordinance Partially Amending the Kokubunji City Ordinance on the Use of Numbers to Identify Specific Individuals in Administrative Procedures
en.summary: The city will amend an ordinance that sets out rules on the use of personal numbers, among other matters. It will set out provisions on specific personal information handled in work related to payments of the child-rearing allowance, among other matters.
changes: Sets out provisions on specific personal information related to payments of the child-rearing allowance, among other matters
en.why: The city says this is to set out provisions on specific personal information handled in work related to payments of the child-rearing allowance, among other matters.
